h08.

Two types declare `RunOnce`, both named `Runner` but in different packages:

`*s3presign.Runner` — yes, invoked from production code — `server/server.go:163` in `(*Server).startBackgroundRunners`, and also internally at `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36` from `(*Runner).Run` (the 12-hour ticker loop)
`*memopayload.Runner` — no, not invoked anywhere — no caller in production or test code

Details:

- `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` declares `func (r *Runner) RunOnce(ctx context.Context)`, which just delegates to `CheckAndPresign`. `server/server.go:162-163` constructs the runner with `s3presign.NewRunner(s.Store)` and calls `RunOnce(ctx)` synchronously before launching `Run` in a goroutine, so the presign pass happens once at startup and then every 12 hours.
- `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` declares `func (r *Runner) RunOnce(ctx context.Context)`, which batch-rebuilds every memo's payload. Nothing calls it: the only imports of the `memopayload` package are in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` and `:447`, and both call the package-level function `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload`, not the method. `memopayload.NewRunner` is likewise never called, so both the `Runner` type's constructor and its `RunOnce` are currently dead code.

I verified this by grepping the whole repository (all text files, including `*_test.go`) for `RunOnce`; the only three files containing the identifier are `server/server.go`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`, and `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`.
